name: zabsreel
description: An open-source video editor built to be operated by AI, not humans. Exposes itself as an MCP server so any MCP-compatible AI client can drive real, local FFmpeg-based edits.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aive/core --workspace @aive/mcp && npm run build:renderer --workspace zabsreel-desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace zabsreel-desktop && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.typecheck:scripts: tsc -p packages/core/scripts && tsc -p packages/mcp/scripts && tsc -p apps/desktop/scripts
scripts.web: npm run build && npm run web --workspace zabsreel-desktop --
